summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in gemini-computer-use@0.4.5
details: Analysis of the three files shipped in gemini-computer-use@0.4.5 produced no indicators of installer-side harm: no lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote code, no reads of installer secret paths (such as ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc), no environment-variable scraping, no hardcoded attacker endpoints, no obfuscated payloads, and no backdoor or persistence mechanisms. No credential-distribution or silent-relay patterns were identified in the shipped code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
